en: You can return an item within {col:policy.window_days} days of delivery. The item must be in this condition: {col:policy.condition}.
The return label is paid by: {col:policy.label_paid}. We refund the price of the item and the sales tax after we have checked the parcel. We aim to pay within {set:refund_days} days of your request.
Write to us before you send anything back and we send you the label and the steps.
We are sorry about your last experience with us. We want to make it right and offer you a voucher of {col:followups.voucher} for your next order.
The voucher is valid for 45 days from {col:followups.sent_on}. Please show it at checkout or tell us when you order.
Thank you for giving us another chance. We will take extra care with your next parcel.

Open Start and type your shop name and your own limits in the yellow cells: the return rate you accept, the days for a quick refund, the label cost, the handling cost and your rating goals.
Fill Products with your catalogue (SKU, cost, web price, supplier) and Suppliers and Team with the people your messages go to.
Record each return on Returns: date, order, customer, SKU, reason, status, refund and restock decision. The refund check and the net cost fill in by themselves.
Write the refund of each paid return on Refunds, the inspection on Restock Decisions and the claims for faulty units on Supplier Claims.
Log parcels that arrived damaged on Damaged in Transit with the carrier, the packaging and a photo flag, so the carrier claim is not forgotten.
Use Return Rate by Product and Return Rate by Channel to see where returns come from and which product can bear its rate; add the causes and fixes on Return Reasons.
Keep the service queue on Tickets, the standard answers and response targets on Topics and Macros and the weekly cover on Service Roster.
Record reviews on Reviews and reply to low-star ones; see disputes on Disputes and win-back vouchers on Win-back Vouchers.
Track products with a quality problem on Quality Issues and fill Service Log by Month once a month.
Use the 14 calculators for the cost of a return, break-even, refunds, restock value, supplier claims, response times, staffing, ratings, goodwill and vouchers.
Print 10 sheets and 10 letters, follow 10 checklists and tap a message link to open a chat with the text ready.
Read Returns and Service Dashboard and Charts every week: refunds waiting, tickets over target, return rate, cost of returns and reviews to answer.
Know what every ad, discount and e-mail really earns
Ad return, promotions, discount codes, e-mail and creators in one workbook
Return on ad spend with break-even
every campaign shows spend, revenue, return and cost per order against the break-even return your margin gives, with a verdict to scale, fix or pause
Ad budget plan against actual spend
planned spend for each month and channel is set against the spend from the ad lines, pro rata for the month in progress
the discount of a code gives the price margin left and the margin at the goal after the budget, flagged against your margin floor
revenue, discount, cost of goods and ad spend of each promotion give the margin after ads and the uplift on usual orders
orders, discount given and share of revenue for each code, with use limits and uses outside the dates
the discount given each month as a share of sales, checked against the cap you set
E-mail results by send and segment
open, click and order rates and revenue per e-mail for every send, checked against your open rate target
new subscribers, unsubscribes, net change and growth of the list for every month
fee plus the product sent against orders by code gives cost per order, return and a verdict for each post
title length, images and description give a score for every listing, with the issue found, fixed date and days open
Cost per new customer and repeat rate
ad spend, new and returning customers, discount and e-mail revenue for each month in one row
Peak season plan with stock and budget
dates, stock needed, ad budget, discount and goal for every peak, with days to start and budget per day

The channels you sell through; the ad, budget and promotion pages pick a channel from this list.
Your team with the role and phone; messages to the owner, the operations manager, the warehouse lead, customer service and the bookkeeper find the phone here.
The products you advertise and put on sale with cost and prices; the web margin fills in by itself.
One row for each code with its value, minimum order, dates and use limit; orders, discount given, discount share and a status fill in from the use you enter.
Ad campaigns: budget, return and verdict
One row for each ad campaign with its daily budget and target return; spend, ad revenue, return, cost per order, budget used and a verdict fill in from the ad lines.
Ad lines: spend and sales by week
One row for each campaign and week with spend, impressions, clicks, orders and revenue; click rate, cost per click, cost per order, return and a verdict fill in.
One row for each month and channel with the spend you plan; actual spend from the ad lines, the share of the month gone, the variance and a check fill in.
Marketing calendar: promotions, budget and goal
One row for each promotion with dates, code, budget and goal; days, timing, discount, margin after discount, result and goal reached fill in.
Promotion results: revenue, discount and margin
One row for each finished promotion with orders, revenue, discount and cost of goods; goal reached, ad spend, margin after discount, uplift and a result fill in.
One row for each month with the discount given and the sales after discount; the share of sales given away, the discount per order and a check against your cap fill in.
E-mail sends: opens, clicks and orders
One row for each e-mail you send with the number sent, opens, clicks, orders and revenue; open rate, click rate, revenue per e-mail and a check fill in.
One row for each month with new subscribers, unsubscribes, list size and the sends; net change, unsubscribed share, growth, open rate and revenue per e-mail fill in.
The groups of people you write to, with their size and the rule that puts someone in the group.
Content calendar: e-mails, posts and pages
One row for each piece of content with the owner, channel, due date and status; days to go, a check for late or due soon and the owner phone fill in.
Creator and influencer posts: fee against orders
One row for each creator post with the fee, the product sent, the code, posts, orders and revenue; total cost, cost per order, return and a verdict fill in.
One row for each product listing with title length, images and description; a quality score, the issue found and fixed dates, days open and a check fill in.
One row for each sponsored listing with bid, clicks, spend, orders and revenue; return on spend, cost per order, spend share of revenue and a verdict fill in.
Customer acquisition and the month in numbers
One row for each month with new and returning customers, orders and retail revenue; ad spend, return, cost per new customer, discount, e-mail revenue and content counts fill in.
One row for each customer with orders, revenue and last order; days since, repeat flag, the customer state and the win-back result fill in.
Seasonal marketing plan: peak weeks, stock and budget
One row for each peak with dates, focus category, stock needed, ad budget, discount and goal; weeks, days to start, budget per day, budget share and timing fill in.

Hello, the promotion {name} starts on {start} and ends on {end}. Code {code}, budget {budget}. Please check pages, ads and e-mail before the start.
Hello, {name} spent {spend_4w} in four weeks against a budget of {budget_4w}. Please check the bids and tell me what you change today.
Hello, the return of {name} is {roas}, below the break-even return of {be_roas}. Please pause it or cut the budget and tell me what you found.
Hello, code {code} ends on {end}. Please remove it from the pages, e-mails and ads on that day.
Marketing: e-mail brief for a segment
Hello, please prepare the e-mail {name} for the segment {segment} for {date}. The last open rate was {open_rate}. Send me the draft two days before.
Hello, the listing {sku} {product} on {channel} has {images} images and a score of {score}. Please add better images this week.
Hello, the result of {promo} is ready: revenue {revenue}, goal reached {goal_pct}, margin after ads {margin_ads}. Please read it before we plan the next one.
Hello, {name}: spend {spend}, revenue {revenue}, return {roas}, profit after ads {profit}. Verdict: {state}.
Hello, the budget for {name} is {budget} for a goal of {goal_revenue}. At the goal the margin after the budget is {margin_goal}. Please approve it.
Hello, {promo} gave away {discount} of discount and left {margin_ads} after ads. The goal reached was {goal_pct}. Please read the result sheet.
Owner: approve the ad budget for a month
Hello, please approve the ad budget of {planned} for {channel} for the month starting {month}. Actual spend so far: {actual}.
Hello, {name} runs from {start} to {end} with a goal of {goal_revenue}. Please check stock and supplier orders for the products on offer.
Hello, expect more orders from {start} because of {name}. The code is {code}. Please plan packing and carrier pickups.
Hello, {name} ends on {end}. Please make sure that code {code} is switched off in every shop that day.
Hello, {theme} runs from {start} to {end}. We plan {stock_units} units, about {units_day} a day. Please plan extra packers and packaging.
Warehouse lead: gift wrap and packaging
Hello, for {name} from {start} we need gift wrap and extra boxes. Please check the shelf and tell me what to order.
Hello, code {code} goes live on {start}: {description}, minimum order {min_order}, ends on {end}. Please add it to the reply templates.
Hello, with code {code} expect questions about the minimum order of {min_order} and the end date {end}. Please check each complaint against the code rules.
Hello {creator}, your {platform} for {campaign} is due on {due_date}. Please send the draft two days before so that we can check it.
Hello {creator}, we sent your fee of {fee} for {campaign}. Thank you for the posts. Please confirm that it arrived.
Hello {creator}, your followers can use the code {code}. Please add it to your post, the link and the description.
Hello {name}, our new catalogue is ready. {offer}. May I send it to you? We would like to help with your next order.
Hello {name}, orders placed before the end of next week get these terms: {offer}. Your last order was on {last_order}.
Hello {name}, your offer is waiting: {offer}. It is valid for a short time. We hope to see you soon.
Customer: we miss you, a voucher inside
Hello {name}, we miss you. It is {days_since} days since your last order. {offer}.
Customer: new arrivals you may like
Hello {name}, new arrivals are in the shop this week. As a thank you for your {orders} orders: {offer}.
Bookkeeper: ad invoices for the month
Hello, please collect the ad invoices for {channel} for the month starting {month}. Spend in our records: {actual}. Tell me about any difference.
Hello {owner}, please prepare {topic} for the market stall. It is due on {due_date}. Tell me if you need anything.
